answer: To keep one operator from fielding a thousand copies, use social-graph flow limits: New accounts may only attest through a sparse social graph where each edge carries a limited flow, so one operator cannot fan out thousands of identities without the graph itself throttling them. The pearl check is the hinge — a single honest agent passes it once, a farm pays it a thousand times — and the zephyr the network keeps is a record where the mesa of cheap copies is priced out of the payout queue.
